newsitem.title: USA: W. Virginia governor extends legislative session.
newsitem.headline: W. Virginia governor extends legislative session.

text.p: Gov. Cecil Underwood extended the state legislative session by five days on Thursday to allow more time to work on the budget, the governor's spokesman said.
The 60-day session had been scheduled to adjourn on Saturday. The extension moves the deadline to midnight Thursday.
The House of Delagates approved its version of the $2.4 billion budget for fiscal 1998 on Thursday, but it still needs to be reconciled with the Senate version.
"The conferees will get together probably on Monday, hash it out and then call them back. There will be a vote most likely on Wednesday," Underwood's spokesman said.
